note: Home list rests on the Billboard year-end Canadian Hot 100; only two francophone songs sourced (ADISQ 2010 nominees, winner not confirmed). No Canadian act topped Canada Country in 2010; country entry is from SOCAN's award for 2010 airplay.
No Canadian act topped Canada Country in 2011; country entry is a Juno nominee/SOCAN country award. 'Hello' is by French DJ Martin Solveig with Toronto's Dragonette as co-lead, counted as home.
Francophone entries come from SOCAN's most-performed francophone lists (galas of Nov 2013 and Dec 2014); the ADISQ 2013 popular-song winner could not be confirmed.
No Canadian act topped Canada Country in 2014 and no other country source was found, so no country entry.
The Tragically Hip's 2016 farewell-year songs are not included: no source naming a specific Hip song as a 2016 hit was found (only their albums reaching number one).
No full 2018 year-end Canadian Hot 100 could be retrieved; home and foreign picks rest on weeks at number one and Nielsen BDS 2018 year-end airplay top 10s, so foreign ranking is approximate.

Thin evidence: no 2019 year-end Canadian Hot 100 or Canadian-artist airplay list could be retrieved. Home list leans on the one Canadian number one, Canada Country number ones, Juno 2020 nominees and ADISQ 2019; Canadian hip hop/R&B of 2019 is unsourced and absent.
